2607.14506.title: Non-vacuous Generalization Bounds for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
2607.14506.paper_summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), the generalizability of the resulting models remains poorly understood. In this work, we establish the first non-vacuous generalization bounds for parameter-efficient RLVR fine-tuning at the billion-parameter scale. Our approach adapts PAC-Bayes compression bounds to this setting, and addresses the inherent stochasticity of token generation by applying the Gumbel-max reparameterization trick. To operationalize these bounds, we propose the Progressive RLVR framework, which integrates RLVR with on-policy distillation, TinyLoRA, and model quantization. Progressive RLVR empirically retains 84-97% performance of standard LoRA fine-tuning while producing models that are 14,796x more compressible. We show that this framework yields non-vacuous generalization bounds in four domains: mathematical problem-solving, programming, general-knowledge reasoning, and Text-to-SQL. Our bounds exceed the accuracy of the base model by 9-51% and lie within 6-11% of the accuracy of the fine-tuned models.
2607.14506.paper_summary_zh: 雖然使用可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）被廣泛應用於提升大型語言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，但所得到模型的可泛化性仍然不甚了解。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們建立了第一個針對十億參數規模的參數高效RLVR微調的非空泛化界限。<lb/>我們的方法將PAC-Bayes壓縮界限適應於此設定，並通過應用Gumbel-max重新參數化技巧來解決令牌生成的固有隨機性。<lb/>為了使這些界限可操作化，我們提出了漸進式RLVR框架，該框架將RLVR與在政策蒸餾、TinyLoRA和模型量化相結合。<lb/>漸進式RLVR在實證中保留了標準LoRA微調的84-97%性能，同時產生的模型可壓縮性提高了14,796倍。<lb/>我們顯示這個框架在四個領域產生了非空的泛化界限：數學問題解決、編程、常識推理和文本到SQL。<lb/>我們的界限超過了基礎模型9-51%的準確率，並且在微調模型的準確率範圍內的6-11%。
